findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "LLM 怎麼產生下一個 token？" → 3 lines (3 words, 112px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "Wiki concept" 1.6:1 (#ffffff on #9ae187); "Wiki concept" 1.6:1 (#ffffff on #b9c8ff)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 1 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 1 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The sheet dealt League Spartan and Figtree, but the page renders Avenir Next, Avenir Next Condensed.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 35px from the left edge but only to 103px from the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: 3 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "S04 pp. 29–31 · Course Materia" (10px from the left); "S08 pp. 3–5 · Research Paper" (10px from the left); "S09 book pp. 179–184 · Reliabl" (10px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: The margins differ: 31px on the left, 54px on the right, at 768px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 2 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 3680px at 10048px; 436px at 13752px (the screen is 844px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.
